Federal Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016 (Ethiopia), art. 2(21): tax year for an individual is 1 Hamle to 30 Sene (8 July to 7 July)
afriref: Ethiopia — VAT standard rate (Proclamation No. 1341/2024, art. 8(2); 15% since Proclamation 285/2002) and registration threshold

caveats: Non-Gregorian tax year (grade P, Federal Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016, art. 2(21)): for an individual the tax year is the one-year period from 1 Hamle to 30 Sene in the Ethiopian calendar, which is 8 July to 7 July in a common Gregorian year. The Gregorian dates shift by a day around the Ethiopian leap month (Pagume, 5-6 days), so the stored start is the common-year approximation.

companyYearEndDefault of 7 July follows the Ethiopian fiscal year (grade S): bodies are taxed on their accounting year, and most Ethiopian businesses use the government fiscal year ending 30 Sene (7 July).

Lower-bound rows - standard (2003-01-01): 15% was set by the repealed VAT Proclamation No. 285/2002 (in force January 2003) and re-enacted unchanged by Proclamation No. 1341/2024, art. 8(2), quoted by afriref (grade S).
Registration threshold of ETB 2,000,000 annual turnover under Proclamation No. 1341/2024 (grade S; the 2024 proclamation raised it from ETB 600,000, effective from its publication on 21 August 2024).
VAT returns are filed monthly (grade S).
